method: Extends the trend.json counterfactual (damped pre-war trend, half-life 3 years, growth capped at +/-10%/yr, multiplier = counterfactual real value in year Y relative to the 2019-2021 real average) to services trade with Russia, taxes paid in Russia by foreign-owned companies, and tanker shipping income on Russian oil and LNG. SERVICES (svc_sold = exports to Russia, incl. Russian tourists' spending; svc_bought = imports from Russia): OECD-WTO BaTiS balanced series by partner, 2012-2021, total services and travel separately, in USD, converted to EUR at ECB annual averages and deflated with the euro-area services HICP (Eurostat prc_hicp_aind SERV, rescaled to 2019-2021 = 1; equals energy2.json price_index.services for 2019-2021). Sensitivity: real USD deflated by the US services CPI; own reports (Eurostat bop_its6_det partner RU, or BaTiS non-imputed own reports) and Russia's own report by partner (Bank of Russia, via BaTiS) are refitted on the same years and the band covers their slopes. Two components: TRAVEL fitted on 2012-2019 only (2020-2021 left out as COVID years); OTHER services (total minus travel) on 2012-2021 without 2020. Window choice as in trend.json (2012-2013 level break -> post-2014 regime 2016-2019 or 2016-2021; else 2014-2015 shock left out; else all years; one gross outlier may be dropped). Because the 2019-2021 base is depressed by COVID, travel multipliers carry a rebound: counterfactual travel = mean(actual 2019, trend 2020, trend 2021) x damped trend x recovery, where the recovery closes the 2021 shortfall against trend by the world pace of tourism recovery (UNWTO arrivals: 49% of the 2021 gap still open in 2022, 17% in 2023, 1% in 2024, none after; x1.5 slower for low, x0.5 for high). Other services fill 2020 with the trend value. The two are weighted by their 2019-2021 actual shares. multiplier_ex_covid gives the damped trend alone relative to a COVID-free 2019-2021 base. base_2021_over_2019_2021 converts to a 2021 base (multiplier / that ratio). Turkey 2016 (Russian sanctions) left out; Egypt travel (flight ban Nov 2015 - Aug 2021) is a level, not a trend. COMPANY TAXES: no pre-2021 series exists; real-EUR 2015-2021 trends of four proxies (income payable on FDI in Russia from the Bank of Russia BoP; inward FDI positions in Russia reported by Russia and by investor countries, IMF DIP; Russian GDP in EUR) give a global trend (mean, band = their range). Per home country: half the country's FDI-position trend, half the global trend. SHIPPING: freight-weighted volume index of Russian seaborne crude, product and LNG exports (Russian seaport throughput, ASOP, 2013-2021), same fit and damping. All multipliers apply to real values: multiply the 2019-2021 real baseline by them, then by the year's price index for nominal values.

damping.formula: m(Y) = exp(g0 + sum_{y=2022..Y} g0*0.5^((y-2021)/H)), g0 = clip(ln(1+g), ln(0.9), ln(1.1)); services multiply this by the COVID rebound described in method

flows.company: taxes paid in Russia by foreign-owned subsidiaries of companies based in the country
flows.shipping: tanker shipping, insurance and registry income on Russian oil and LNG exports
